Summary: The sources mention four knowledge-intensive generation datasets supporting sentence-level facts in the DRAGIN framework: "Interleaving retrieval with chain-of-thought reasoning for knowledge-intensive multi-step questions" by Harsh Trivedi et al., "DRAGON: Domain-specific Robust Automatic Data Generation" by Hu and Lu, "Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)" by Zhao et al., and "Retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-intensive NLP tasks" by Lewis et al. These papers provide the foundational concepts and methodologies for enhancing large language models through retrieval-augmented generation, which DRAGIN leverages to improve its performance on knowledge-intensive tasks.
